Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise. Immunities: Cursed. +Follower Summon Spell: Reraise

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise. Immunities: Cursed. Summon Stats: +15%

gear.notes: Gear of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus was once a Judge of Elysium, but was later banished to the Dark Rift. His followers followed him to the Underworld below. Follower Stats: +15% · Bestial Bond: +7%

gear.name: Zagreus Rete
gear.notes: Weapon of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus carried two items -- one polearm and one net. Grants ability: Call of Zagreus. Follower Stats: +7% · Bestial Bond: Level 1

gear.name: Zeta Riftlock
gear.notes: A strange Riftlock of unknown origin. When carrying this Riftlock in Anguished content, less Ascension Levels will be forfeited when applying Ascension Shackles. Additionally, Ascension Shackles will provide more rewards and proofs. Bonus Shackled Ascension Levels: 5 / Shackled Rewards: +15%

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: A skilled individual who favors magic over strength. It can wield staves and robes.

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: A tricky fighting class that favors speed and damage over defense. It can wield light armor, daggers, bows.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: A melee class who favors physical attacks and brute strength over magic. It can wield heavier weapons and armor.

classes.name: Archmage
classes.description: An Avalon mage who has learned the basics of conjuring magic. It can wield the equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Footsoldier
classes.description: A Lyonesse soldier that can imbue their attacks with elemental properties. It can wield the equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Frost Mage
classes.description: A mage of the Frozenguard that has mastered the arts of the cold.

classes.name: Legionnaire
classes.description: A soldier of the Earthen Legion that has mastered the arts of the ground below them.

classes.name: Royal Guard
classes.description: Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite and passives.

classes.name: Scorcher / Scorchess
classes.description: A rogue of the Inferno Knights. This fighting class can learn rare fire magic.

classes.name: Strider
classes.description: A fighter well versed in various weaponry. It can wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Wanderer / Wanderess
classes.description: Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite and passives.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite and passives.

classes.name: Court Mage
classes.description: A practitioner of magic that has been promoted to the role of Avalon Court Mage. It can wield the equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: A fledgling handler of great Nothren beasts. It can wield the equipment of the warrior or thief.

classes.name: Shadowmaker
classes.description: A fighter of Annwn versed in the dark arts. It can wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Squire
classes.description: A warrior trained in the defensive art of swordplay. It can wield the equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Augur
classes.description: An alternative version of the Mystic class. Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite.

classes.name: Gladiator
classes.description: An alternative version of the Adept class. Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite.

classes.name: Lancer
classes.description: A hybrid class that favors all but magic. It can wield equipment of both the thief and warrior.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.description: A hybrid class that mixes dexterity and magic. It can wield equipment of both the thief and mage.

classes.name: Runeblade
classes.description: An alternative version of the Spellsword class. Purchase this class to support the game and gain an alternative sprite.

classes.name: Spellsword
classes.description: A hybrid class that mixes defense and magic. It can wield equipment of both the warrior and mage.

classes.name: Wolf Tamer
classes.description: A novice handler of great Nothren beasts. It can wield the equipment of the warrior or thief.

classes.name: Cavalry
classes.description: A warrior of Lyonesse that rides the fiercest of horses. It can wield equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A magician skilled in the art of channeling the powers of beasts in battle. It can wield equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Majestic
classes.description: A royal servant to the kingdom of Annwn, skilled in debilitating offense. It can wield equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Spirit Tamer
classes.description: A skilled handler of great Nothren beasts. It can wield the equipment of the warrior or mage.

classes.name: Dragoon / Valkyrie
classes.description: A warrior that has mastered the art of taming dragons. It can wield the equipment of the warrior or thief.

classes.name: Shadowmancer
classes.description: A mystical fighter of Annwn that mixes magic and dexterity. It can dodge attacks more effectively as damage is taken and can wield equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Spellweaver
classes.description: A very skilled magic user that can cast spells repetitively. It has a good chance casting spells for free and can wield equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Templar
classes.description: A graduated knight of Lyonesse armed to the teeth in mythril. It learns more complex weapon arts and can wield the equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Archdruid
classes.description: A powerful magician skilled in the art of channeling the powers of beasts in battle. It is naturally strong against the powers of light and dark and can wield equipment of the thief and mage.

classes.name: Attuner
classes.description: A novice summoner of Elysium. Summoners themselves are not very powerful beings, but can summon powerful entities to join the battle. Summoners can wield the equipment of the mage but cannot tame followers.

classes.name: Grand Dragoon / Grand Valkyrie
classes.description: A Valhallan that rides with the most powerful of dragons. It is naturally strong against dragon magic and can wield equipment of both the warrior and mage.

classes.name: Majistrate
classes.description: An elite force of the kingdom of Annwn, skilled in elemental offense. It is naturally strong against arcane magic and can wield equipment of both the warrior and thief.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: An elite force of the kingdom of Lyonesse, skilled in elemental offense. It is naturally strong against the forces of dark and light and can wield equipment of both the warrior and mage.

classes.name: Arcanic
classes.description: A deadly risk taking rogue of Annwn trained in lost arcane techniques. It is immune to arcane magic and can wield equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Atlas Vanguard / Athena Vanguard
classes.description: A stalwart holy warrior of Lyonesse that is well versed in methods of ward and survivability. It is immune to holy magic and can wield equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Freyr / Freyja
classes.description: A Valhallan that is one of the highest order of Nothren warriors and valkyries. It is immune to dragon magic, has special bonds with beasts, and can wield equipment of the warrior or mage.

classes.name: Gaia
classes.description: A knight of nature and balance who has truly mastered the powers of the earth below. It is immune to earthen magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Grand Attuner
classes.description: An adept summoner of Elysium. Summoners themselves are not very powerful beings, but can automatically summon powerful entities to join the battle. Summoners can wield the equipment of the mage but cannot tame followers.

classes.name: Ifrit
classes.description: A knight of smoke and ash who has truly mastered the powers of the flame. It is immune to fire magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Leviathan
classes.description: A knight of tide and ice who has truly mastered the powers of the seas. It is immune to water magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Nekromancer / Nekromagus
classes.description: An exiled magus of Avalon that utilizes the dark powers of the fallen to overcome its foes. It is immune to dark magic and can wield the equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Taranis
classes.description: A knight of lightning and thunder who has truly mastered the powers of the skies. It is immune to lightning magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Bahamut
classes.description: A Valhallan that has fused themselves with mighty dragons, learning the secrets of combining might with magic. Their offense is determined by both attack and magic stats, is immune to Dragon magic, and can wield equipment of both the warrior and mage.

classes.name: Bahamut Auriga
classes.description: A Bahamut that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Bahamut Hydrus
classes.description: A Bahamut that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Grand Ifrit
classes.description: An elite force of smoke and ash who has truly mastered the powers of the flame. It is immune to fire magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Great Leviathan
classes.description: An elite force of tide and ice who has truly mastered the powers of the seas. It is immune to water magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: High Taranis
classes.description: An elite force of lightning and thunder who has truly mastered the powers of the skies. It is immune to lightning magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Noble Gaia
classes.description: An elite force of nature and balance who has truly mastered the powers of the earth below. It is immune to earthen magic and can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Nyx
classes.description: An elusive assassin of Annwn. It is well versed in finding ways to survive in battle, is immune to Dark magic, and can wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Nyx Corvus
classes.description: A Nyx that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Nyx Hercules
classes.description: A Nyx that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Omnimancer / Omnimagus
classes.description: An unorthodox magus of Avalon that has achieved true affinity with all four basic elements. It can cast multi-elemental spells and can occasionally resist the damage of any basic element. It wields the equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Omnimancer Antlia / Omnimagus Antlia
classes.description: An Omnimancer that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Omnimancer Ara / Omnimagus Ara
classes.description: An Omnimancer that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.description: A celebrated summoner of Elysium. Summoners themselves are not very powerful beings, but can automatically summon powerful entities to join the battle. Summoners can wield the equipment of the mage but cannot tame followers.

classes.name: Summoner Auriga
classes.description: A Summoner that has reached the stars above. It sacrifices pact power for that of its summons.

classes.name: Summoner Hydrus
classes.description: A Summoner that has reached the stars above. It sacrifices summon power for additional power when using pacts.

classes.name: Titanguard
classes.description: A seasoned and stalwart holy warrior of Lyonesse that is strongly versed in methods of ward and survivability. It is immune to holy magic and can wield equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Titanguard Hercules
classes.description: A Titanguard that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Titanguard Ursa
classes.description: A Titanguard that has reached the stars above.

classes.name: Beowulf / Bestla
classes.description: A storied rank of those aligned with Dragons, this Valhallan class brings the tales, poems, and stances of war into battle and favors unconventional weaponry. Their offense is determined by both attack and magic stats, is immune to Dragon magic, and can wield any piece of equipment found.

classes.name: Beowulf Auriga / Bestla Auriga
classes.description: A Beowulf that has reached the stars above. It has the strongest bonds with followers and may allow them to act twice per turn.

classes.name: Beowulf Hydrus / Bestla Hydrus
classes.description: A Beowulf that has reached the stars above. It trades the bond built with followers for increased stats and hybrid power.

classes.name: Deity
classes.description: The ancient elves believed they could break the traditions of elemental alignment, but never quite succeeded. Deities, relics of this time, utilize unstable elemental affinities to gain both protection, and weakness, to the elements. These skilled warriors can wield equipment of the warrior, mage, or thief.

classes.name: Deity Ara
classes.description: A Deity that has reached the stars above. Its magical prowess becomes stronger as Apex abilities are utilized in battle.

classes.name: Deity Ursa
classes.description: A Deity that has reached the stars above. It gains the upper hand after utilizing Apex abilities in battle.

classes.name: Gilgamesh / Gallia
classes.description: A seldomly encountered warrior who specializes in using their defenses as a weapon. This class grows stronger with Ward upkeep and can convert their defenses into damage or regenerative effects. They can wield the equipment of the warrior and are immune to arcane magic while resistant to powers of the dragons.

classes.name: Gilgamesh Hercules / Gallia Hercules
classes.description: A Gilgamesh that has reached the stars above. It is most effective at utilizing Ward-based abilities.

classes.name: Gilgamesh Ursa / Gallia Ursa
classes.description: A Gilgamesh that has reached the stars above. It trades Ward for HP and is most effective at utilizing Collateral Damage and two-handed weapons. It can additionally wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Grand Summoner
classes.description: The highest ranking summoner of Elysium. Summoners themselves are not very powerful beings, but can automatically summon powerful entities to join the battle. Summoners can wield the equipment of the mage but cannot tame followers.

classes.name: Grand Summoner Auriga
classes.description: A Grand Summoner that has reached the stars above. It is most effective at utilizing a full field of summoned allies. It can additionally wield the equipment of the warrior.

classes.name: Grand Summoner Hydrus
classes.description: A Grand Summoner that has reached the stars above. It is most effective at sacrificing summons for its own power. It can additionally wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Heretic / Hera
classes.description: Once followers of Apollyon, these exiled warlocks favor the more destructive magic and become stronger as their mana fades. Critical hits of their spells deal extra damage. Additionally, they have attuned themselves to the basic elements and can wield equipment of the mage.

classes.name: Heretic Ara / Hera Ara
classes.description: A Heretic that has reached the stars above. It is most effective at utilizing celestial magic.

classes.name: Heretic Corvus / Hera Corvus
classes.description: A Heretic that has reached the stars above. It is more effective at charging Manaflasks and is more evasive in battle. It can additionally wield the equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Realmshifter
classes.description: Masters of all that is clandestine, ancient Annwn's realmshifters have the ability to always find the cutting edge in battle. Their critical hits deal extra damage. Additionally, they can see in the dark, are immune to the powers of light & dark, and can wield equipment of the thief.

classes.name: Realmshifter Corvus
classes.description: A Realmshifter that has reached the stars above. It is most effective at capitalizing on critical hits.

classes.name: Realmshifter Dorado
classes.description: A Realmshifter that has reached the stars above. It trades offense for defense and evasive capabilities. It can additionally wield the equipment of the warrior.
